name: Irisu Makina
source:
A first-year student of Mihama Academy, Makina is an innocent and carefree girl. For some unexplainable reasons, it’s hard to understand her personality. In general, she can be explained in one word, “Fool”, but sometimes her speech and behavior can make people shed cold sweat. For that uniqueness, most of people who talk with her for 5 minutes will say “This girl is awful”. Makina adores [url=/c567]Yuuji[/url] as an older brother and [url=/c568]Amane[/url] as an older sister, and calls Yuuji “Onii-chan”. Although she has her own room in the dormitory, for some reason, she always stays in Amane’s room. Because of her parents' work, she stayed in foreign countries until she was 6 so she can talk English. [spoiler]Her family is rumored to be a large financial clique which controls the underworld of Japan, but almost nobody knows the unhappiness which she suffered from being born in such a troublesome family. She used to be the successor of Irisu family but her inheritance right was transferred to her younger sister, Irisu Sarina, after she suffered a mental shock in an accident relating to her father. Despite all of that, she still has 70 million yen as her own property.[/spoiler]

Her representative fruit is strawberry.

[From Shiori-chan's review]
